notes.title: Microcosmum 2 is already on Steam !!!
notes.content:
[h3]We are pleased to announce that Microcosmum 2 will be available on Steam soon![/h3]

Microcosmum 2 has become much larger. It has a constructor of organisms, the action of the game takes place on the global map in real time.
You will now build buildings, conquer territories and create your own organisms.
Microcosmum has become much larger, better, more beautiful and retained its style and deep atmosphere.

[h2][b]Add to your wishlist !!![/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9531401/25cc1ee6e338fa3f715a0d97414e909825f71718.gif[/img]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486140/Microcosmum_2/

tags.feature: You will now build buildings, conquer territories and create your own organisms.

notes.title: DLC Campaign "Hot And Cold"
notes.content:
[h1]We glad to present you new big DLC Campaign "Hot And Cold"![/h1]

Temperature fluctuations appeared in the microcosmum.
Now microorganisms slow down in cold areas and accelerate in warm ones.
Use it in your tactics! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048360/Microcosmum_survival_of_cells__Campaign_Hot_And_Cold/

notes.title: DLC "Aliens"
notes.content:
[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c837434/v837434121/6ae9c/N36qdOpsLD8.jpg[/img]

[h1]We glad to present you new big DLC "Aliens"![/h1]

Other organisms were discovered in the microcosmum. They do not have a nucleus and breed from nests.
Some of them are aggressive and attack organisms, others are not dangerous, but they interfere with organisms.

Introducing an additional campaign of 50 levels, on which you will meet new species of organisms. Study their features and use it in your tactics to defeat the enemy.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/736450/Microcosmum_survival_of_cells__Campaign_Aliens/

notes.content:

[h1]We have 3 news for you:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Game update to version 2.4.
    [*]"Random levels" dlc update.
    [*]New DLC "New life".
[/list]


[h1]DLC "New life":[/h1]

We glad to present you new big DLC "New life"!
It's a new campaign of 51 levels with new game content. You will face 5 bosses, each with unique abilities. 
Every level belong to one of 5 types with features related to his boss. 
Defeat bosses and get their abilities.

    [*]New game content.
    [*]5 bosses.
    [*]5 abilities for player.
[/list]

[list]
    [*]In game options added button to reset player progress.
    [*]Language selection in options.
    [*]Rebalanced difficulty for many levels.
    [*]Camera will not go away from level limits.
    [*]Improved balance for antibodies at level.
    [*]Fixed bug when organism ignores commands.
[/list]


[h1]DLC update - Random Levels:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Balanced neutral, enemy and player organisms ratio.
    [*]Added traps, bombs and other game elements.
    [*]Added decor elements.
    [*]Added obstacles.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Update 2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c625123/v625123722/3e9f1/_LRxGxHpUtc.jpg[/img]

[h1]We glad to present you new version of Microcosmum![/h1]
Changes were made almost to every part of game. Gameplay, visual, audio and tech are significantly improved.
Now every single level has unique landscape, that you may use for your advance.
Improved AI now has few difficulty levels. Choose one that suits most to your gameplay preferences: meditation or hardcore battle.
New visual effects and new soundtracks will bring you deeper to game atmosphere.


[h1] New content:	[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Unique landscape for each level.
    [*]Added decorations for levels.
    [*]Added new gameplay elements.
[/list]

[h1]Sound:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added new music and reworked old one.
    [*]Some old sound reworked and new added.
[/list]

[h1]Interface:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Game difficulty levels.
    [*]Screen resolution selection moved to options dialog.
    [*]New cursor added.
    [*]Added option to bind keyboard keys.
    [*]2 old level packages were transferred to 1.
    [*]Levels numeration added.
    [*]Interface animations and visual effects.
[/list]

[h1]Controls:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Several organisms selection.
    [*]Select all organisms at once.
    [*]Add organism to selection.
[/list]

[h1]Textures improved:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Neutral organisms
    [*]Levels background
    [*]Backgrounds particles
    [*]Organisms highlight
[/list]

Steam Cloud support added
Organisms trail
Organisms upgrade effect reworked
Command click effect added
Improved AI now more complicated
4 difficulty levels 
Levels background animated
Antibodies generation and organisms upgrades rebalanced
Rebalanced evolution system
Tutorial updated


[h1]Bugfix:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Camera scroll with mouse on screen side.
    [*]Organisms and antibodies selection.
    [*]Organisms and antibodies controls.
    [*]German localization fix.
[/list]

notes.title: First Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone! We are happy to announce the first update Microcosmum: survival of cells!	[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Completely redesigned game interface. Now the interface is accurate and intuitive.
    [*]Control sustem reworked. It has become more convenient and easier. You also can check changes in tutorial.
    [*]Added volume control for effects and music.
    [*]Changed the way of antibodies selection. You can switch selection mode in options menu.
